$comment: Repo-portable Claude Code plugin config. Makes obra/Superpowers (MIT; no keys) available + enabled for anyone who opens this repo. Codex/Copilot install via their own plugin marketplace — see scripts/setup-agent-tools.sh and docs/agent-tooling.md. Opt out by setting enabledPlugins.superpowers... to false or removing this block. The SessionStart hook runs scripts/ensure-hooks-path.sh (shared with the Codex, Cursor and Copilot session-start hooks), which points core.hooksPath at .githooks when it is unset; see that script and docs/agent-tooling.md.
